rules.ladder_rule: a book's alternate rungs count as listed only when the whole ladder is consistent with that book's own two-sided line (every lower rung at least as likely, every higher rung at most as likely, within 3 pts) and never rises with the line; otherwise the ladder is unverified and research-only
